text: Hi, yeah, I'm Bill Carter. I just want to know how much it costs to replace a whole bathroom's plumbing.
For specific jobs like a bathroom remodel, we need to send a technician out to evaluate the job. Our standard diagnostic visit is $89. Would you like to schedule an appointment for Monday?
No, I don't need an appointment. Can you just give me a rough idea of the cost?
We don't have flat pricing for whole bathroom replacements without an in-person assessment. If you change your mind and would like to schedule a diagnostic visit for $89, just let me know.
Come on, you must have some kind of ballpark figure. Surely it's not a complete mystery?

Every bathroom layout and scope of work is different, so we can't provide a ballpark figure over the phone. We'd be happy to send a technician out for an $89 diagnostic visit to give you an accurate quote.
Thank you for calling Lakeside Plumbing & Heating. Have a great weekend!
